sections.changelog:
Added

  • Ticker layout: "Photo Spacing" setting to control the horizontal distance between photos in the strip (the other layouts already had a gap control). Available in both the global defaults and per-collection settings.

Fixed

  • Ticker layout reset visibly when the loop restarted instead of scrolling seamlessly. The animation now shifts the track by the exact measured distance to the first duplicated set (via `offsetLeft`/`offsetTop`, transform-independent and free of gap double-counting), so the loop is seamless for any number of photos and copies, in both horizontal and vertical directions. Ticker clones are also excluded from the lightbox and stripped of duplicate ids.
